instruction.text: Drag the adverbial phrases to the correct categories.
Which type of adverbial is used to link the paragraphs?

atoms.a:
Before Erik went to work at the hospital, he went to the shops to get some ingredients. He went to buy mushrooms, tofu and noodles.

After work, he is going to cook ramen for his friends. Most of his friends do not eat meat, so he is going to make a vegan meal.

feedback.end: A new paragraph is often used when there is a change of tense. In this example, the tenses change from past tense to future tense.

atoms.a:
There is a new café at the end of the road that I would like to visit. Next week, my dad and I are going to go and see what lunch options they have.

Most of the time my dad and I go to cafés in town, so it will be nice to try somewhere new.

feedback.end: A new paragraph is often used when there is a change of location. The adverbials of place “at the end of the road” and “in town” show this change.

atoms.a:
My mum and I spent the day together yesterday. Firstly, we went shopping. We enjoyed going to charity shops to find second hand clothes.

Secondly, we went to a burger restaurant for dinner. My mum had a halloumi burger and I had some chicken wings.

feedback.end: The adverbials of number “firstly” and “secondly” link the paragraphs by ordering the two events.

instruction.text: Select the correct adverbials to link the paragraphs.

atoms.b:
((++In_January, Last_January)) my family is moving to Manchester because my mum has been promoted within the company that she works for.

As a result of the move, ((++next_year, last_year,)) my brother and I will start at a new school.

Tim collects horse chestnuts in the autumn. There is a tree ((++in_the_park at_6pm)) that drops lots of them every year.

He takes the horse chestnuts ((++home tomorrow)), where he paints them with nail varnish to preserve them.

Rafael wanted to make a packed lunch for himself. ((++Firstly Thirdly)), he went to the bakers to get some fresh bread. He picked out some nice crusty rolls, paid and thanked the bakery staff.

((++Secondly Firstly)), he went to the supermarket to get some cheese. He considered getting some Red Leicester but eventually settled on a classic cheddar.
